page.overview:
Who is Director?

Sonya Blade|Games=Mortal Kombat (2011 video game) (Challenge Tower)}}

The Director is a minor character in Johnny Cage's Challenge Tower in the 2011 video game Mortal Kombat. He appears in Challenge 17 "I'm a Celebrity" as a playable character, but does not have an X-Ray Move or any Special Moves; however, he can combo, block and grab. The Director also appears as an opponent in Challenge 127 "Cut!".
